description: Stage a commercial holding portfolio, LLC cluster, or multiline address list for interactive curation in Chat / MCP. Automatically discovers sister entities, detects Homestead HQ vs commercial holdings, flags each property as selected, and computes aggregate overassessment delta and potential tax savings.

addresses.description: Optional array of street address strings

default_city.description: Default city if omitted in address line (default: Chattanooga)

query.description: Search query: owner name, LLC name, or primary address (e.g. 'Noble Nooga Properties LLC' or '810 Lindsay Ave')

text_addresses.description: Optional raw pasted multiline text with 1 address per line

name: stage_portfolio_selection
